description: This file defines the 'LoginPage' React component for the frontend of a web application. It manages user login functionality, including form handling, validation, API interaction, and UI rendering specific to the login page.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the login page UI, handles user input, validation, and login request processing.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous function invoked when the user submits the login form. Validates input, calls login API, handles success and error cases, and manages UI state.
